cohort: The study included 978 neonates from two tertiary Neonatal Intensive Care Units (NICUs) between July 1, 2023, and June 30, 2024.
finding: Neonatal sepsis significantly increased attributable length of stay by 11 days and hospitalization costs by $6,035.34, with Gram-positive bacteria, particularly Staphylococcus epidermidis, being the predominant pathogens showing high multidrug resistance.
